headline: APEC Businesspeople Call for Removing Barriers to Food Trade
summary: The APEC Business Advisory Council called on member economies to mitigate and avoid new non-tariff measures on food trade by applying APEC principles.
why: Non-tariff measures such as standards and licensing rules can raise costs and restrict cross-border food trade, affecting agribusiness companies.
original_headline: Empresarios de APEC piden quitar barreras al comercio alimentario
